messages.subject: Re: label cases in scatter matrix
messages.body_plain:
I am not sure  I understand what you want to achieve.
But if you wanted to discern the points or lines or both by country. You could just put the country as a shape or a colour to stratify by in deducer plot builder.
You may have to right click and break out to access these submenus.
